title: Kagamine Len — Uncontrollable Curiosity〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Man, I can't wait to see what this venue looks like!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It is where RAD WEEKEND took place.
The very thing that Kohane and the others are trying to surpass.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: On top of that, this venue seems to mean quite a lot to both An and Akito.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True. After all, it's where their dreams and feelings were born...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly! That's why I'm looking forward to seeing it so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But all we know so far is that it's not a particularly big live house or anything.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was under the impression that it'd be this huge place with tons of people because it's being touted as such a legendary event...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it's not supposed to be all that different from the live houses where Kohane and the others usually perform, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's what I heard as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which makes it even more amazing, right?! I mean, this place pretty much went from zero to hero!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see your point. No ordinary event would be remembered in such a way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm still not really sure how amazing it was.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone who performed that night had to be absolutely outta this world, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure they were.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you need more than just performers to put on an event like that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've seen what the events Kohane and the others usually perform at are like, haven't you? Try starting there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
An event isn't just about singers.
You need something else to really make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about the staff and crowd...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bingo.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We have no way of knowing just what kind of event RAD WEEKEND really was...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we know for a fact that events can only happen when everyone works together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Singers, songs, lights, an MC to act as a bridge, and an audience to energize. Or in some cases, to receive energy from...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All of these factors meld together in different ways...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And only then do you get to see an event start to take shape.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Seeing an event take shape...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Our goal's usually to make sure the crowd has fun while listening to our songs...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that's not enough, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's also important to keep in mind since it's just as much a part of what makes an event “good”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But “legendary” is a different story.
What you said likely wouldn't be enough to elevate it to that level.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, does this have anything to do with “oneness”?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd have to say not quite.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not quite...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know it's not a great answer and it's not like I witnessed RAD WEEKEND firsthand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Same. All we can do is imagine what happened.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The next time you get to see Kohane and the others perform in an event, it might be good to try and see things from a broader perspective.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
A broader perspective...?
Now you really got me confused.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, going to the venue where RAD WEEKEND happened might give you a better insight.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But what kind of insight?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ugh, you're no help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wish I knew what you two were talking about.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, if I don't figure this out, I won't be able to help Kohane or anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They have been growing at a very steady pace.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No... If this keeps up, I just won't have what it takes to help them! That'd be the opposite of cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means I need to practice more!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I get to see a legendary place, so I need to put myself in the right state of mind!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mind if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You will?! Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome. Shall we?
